summary: Full Stage 1 E2E test of FMCC. Backend: 16 pytest flow tests (setup/409, detect, home, squad identity matching, save reading + auto backups, departures/joins, search, careers create/switch, folder, live GitHub updates check + apply/rollback, auto-install, backups + restore). Found & fixed 1 critical bug (POST /api/backups 500 due to Mongo _id leaking). After fix 16/16 pass. Frontend: setup wizard, Home cards/attention/next match, read-save toast & date advance, Same name / New tags, departed section, filters, player sheet + chart + ?player= deep link, command palette (Ctrl+K, players, actions), Settings careers/new career/switch/folder, updates apply/rollback, auto-install persistence, backup restore dialog + date rollback, placeholder routes, sidebar at 1920x800/1366x768, mobile 390. All requested flows work; a few minor issues listed. DB left cleared (fresh, setup not complete).

critical.issue: FIXED: returned 500 (ObjectId not serializable) because create_backup() passed `doc` to insert_one which mutated it with _id, then returned doc. Backup was stored but the UI 'Back up now' showed an error. Fixed by insert_one(dict(doc)).

minor.issue: Restoring also restores the 'settings' doc, so app preferences (auto_install_updates, last_update_check) revert to the backup's values. Consider excluding app prefs from restore (only careers/identities/snapshots/active_career_id/setup_complete).
Restore does delete_many then insert_many per collection without a transaction; a failure mid-restore leaves partial data (a pre-restore backup exists, so recoverable).
Only automatic backups are pruned (MAX 20). Manual and 'Before restoring a backup' backups hold a full data copy and are never pruned -> unbounded growth.
Unauthenticated GitHub API (60 req/hr/IP), 4 calls per check -> ~15 checks/hr before every component shows 'Couldn't check'. Not in io_lock either. Consider caching/throttling or a GITHUB_TOKEN env.

Backup reason 'Before reading save #N' and counts.snapshots are global across careers, so with 2 careers the labels are ambiguous (e.g. 'Before reading save #1 · 4 saves'). Include career name in reason.

ui_bugs.issue: Command palette 'Back up my data now' created TWO Manual backups (two toasts). useEffect that calls backup() is not idempotent and React.StrictMode double-invokes effects in dev. Same pattern for ?check=1. Guard with a useRef flag (or remove param before acting).

issues: Home grid overflows .content by ~4px: Needs-your-attention card right edge at 1370px (cut off, no right gutter).
Development card minute bars (.mbars .track) collapse to ~7px wide - unreadable.
Card number captions wrap awkwardly ('Best XI / average ability', 'weeks to season / end'); Elite Training title wraps to 2 lines. Consider collapsing bento to 2 columns below ~1440px.

action_items: Make ?backup=1 / ?check=1 handlers in BackupsCard/UpdatesCard idempotent (useRef guard) so palette actions run once
Fix Home bento layout at ~1366px (overflow + 7px minute bars)
Decide whether backup restore should revert app settings (auto-install, last check); probably exclude
Prune manual/pre-restore backups or cap total backups
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_backup: insert_one mutated returned dict (fixed).
read_next_save creates the backup and inserts the snapshot before the optimistic career update; on 409 the snapshot/identities are already written (io_lock makes this unlikely in practice).
rollback_update sets status 'update_available' unconditionally even if previous_version >= latest.
Frontend: Home/Squad queries have no error state (Home shows 'Loading your club…' forever on API error).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; double-backup and 1366 layout issues)

seed_data_creation: Created test careers (TEST_Career A/B, TEST_Second career) during tests; all test collections cleared at the end as requested (settings, careers, identities, snapshots, backups, components are empty; /api/state shows setup_complete=false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file test_fmcc_stage1.py requires an EMPTY DB (clear settings/careers/identities/snapshots/backups/components in test_database first) and runs sequentially in one class; run with `-n 0`. It mutates components.fmmatchlens to v0.7.0 to test apply/rollback via live GitHub (skips if GitHub rate-limited). Clear the DB again after running so the user sees first-run setup.
